description: a cylinder of radius 1 from z 0 to 2 with a ring torus about it, major radius 1 and minor 0.4 centred at z 1, written by Open CASCADE with every closed edge split in two (ShapeUpgrade_ShapeDivideClosedEdges): the circle at z 1.4 where the torus meets the cylinder above is two half circles between the cylinder and the torus, both faces carrying their seam at one vertex (ADR-0041). One half filleted at r 0.1: a torus against a cylinder, both turning, concave, the chain runs on through both vertices and closes as a whole ring, two half tori. Open CASCADE builds the ring as one face

analytic.counts_differ: Open CASCADE builds the blend of the ring (a cylinder's circle against a torus) as one face spanning a whole turn, V/E/F/L 10/15/7/7, where Arris builds one face per arc and a junction arc and two vertices at each vertex of the split, 12/18/8/8 (ADR-0041); the part and the blend are the same solid, the measures and probes agree with the oracle's
analytic.step_differs: Open CASCADE's own STEP of the result carries its 10/15/7/7 where Arris's carries its 12/18/8/8, one whole-turn blend face against two halves (counts_differ)
